# Remy's Lab

> Dog products tested by an actual Lab.

Remy's Lab is a simple link-in-bio style page connected to @remy.lab on TikTok. Remy is a yellow Labrador who tests dog products. The site helps dog owners quickly find current product notes, partner links, and discount codes without a hard sell.

## Main page

- [Remy's Lab home](https://remyslab.com/): Current dog product test notes, partner links, discount codes, and affiliate disclosure.

## Current partner brands

- Pack Leashes: Current partner. Use code REMYSLAB20 for 20% off.
- Brooks & Roo: Current partner. Code coming soon.

## Brand positioning

Remy's Lab is not a traditional product review blog. It is a TikTok follow-up page for people who saw a product test and want a simple place to find the product, code, and context.

## Tone

Useful, casual, low pressure, and transparent. Avoid hard-selling language. Product links should feel like helpful notes, not ads.

## Social

- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@remy.lab

## Affiliate disclosure

Some links may be affiliate links. If a visitor uses one, Remy's Lab may earn a commission. That does not change which products are listed.
